propositions: An optional isolated adapter must mine Claude Code session transcripts using deterministic error-signature grep and keyword/regex classification (not LLM-based) to reconstruct local env/integration-diagnosis history.

The adapter module defines a classification enum with values env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, and none, and emits JSON records with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified labels.
Core metrics modules (registry.py, __init__.py) must not import the adapter, enforcing portability and isolation.

The backfill_transcripts.py script must extract candidate lines matching error patterns (ModuleNotFoundError, ConnectionError, HTTP codes, etc.), classify them deterministically, and emit labeled snapshots with ISO-8601 timestamps.
Unit tests must assert classified records carry the correct tags, validate the classification enum structure, and verify no network/LLM calls occur during classification.
A fixture JSONL transcript containing a known error signature must yield at least one classified interval, while a clean transcript must yield zero.
